desc: Renders the network-filter trigger pill: either the selected chain's ChainLogo plus its display name and an X clear button, or an overlapped stack of the first three chain logos with the label "All" and a chevron.
note: Defined inside NetworkFilterSheet.tsx alongside NetworkFilterSheet (the sheet itself is a separate Penpot component).

desc: Renders the payment-request builder: a tappable asset row (TokenLogo + symbol + network name + chevron), a decimal amount field with the token ticker and a hint line, and an AppModal holding a TokenSelector for picking the asset.
Renders a horizontally scrollable row of content-sized text segments with a spring-animated bg.sunken chip behind the active one, plus an optional numeric badge and leading icon per segment.

Renders a drag-to-commit control: a raised hairline-bordered track with a centered muted label and hint plus an accent knob the user pans to the end, interpolating the track to success green on commit and dimming at 0.45 opacity when disabled.

Renders the home bottom dock: a full-bleed bar on bg.raised with a 1px top hairline, a circular Scan FAB overlapping the bar's top edge by half, and Receive (secondary) + Send (primary/accent) pill buttons flanking the FAB slot.
note: The primary/secondary variant axis lives on the file-private DockButton, not on WaveDock's own props.

desc: Renders a circular network mark: the remote logoURL image, falling back on load error to a bgColor circle containing the chain's short label.

Renders a contact avatar — an address-seeded Identicon when the avatar-style preference is 'identicon' and the address is valid, otherwise the name's initial over a deterministic muted HSL tint — with a small Wallet badge when kind is 'account'.
Renders a deterministic Nimiq identicon as inline SVG (assembled from identicons-esm params, cached by lowercased seed) clipped to a circle of `size`.
Renders the QR matrix for `value` as a single SVG path over a background rect, in a viewBox sized to the module count so it stays seamless at any `size`.

Renders a fixed 360px white share card: Vela brand header, framed QR, account name, then either the request summary plus short address (variant 'request') or the short address plus a grid of supported-network chips (variant 'address'), over a getvela.app footer.
note: Single prop `model: ShareCardModel`; the visual variant axis is model.variant.

desc: Renders a circular token image from the first working URL candidate (falling through logoUrl then logoUrls on image error to a letter monogram tinted from the symbol), with a ChainLogo badge at ~45% size on the bottom-right when `chain` is set.

Renders the account avatar — an address-seeded Identicon when the avatar-style preference is 'identicon' (wrapped in a pressable that opens the large viewer when enlargeable), otherwise the name's initial in a soft accent circle.

Renders a money figure as one fit-to-width line — leading currency symbol, integer part at `size`, and a subordinated tail (decimal fraction + unit) — shrinking to `minScale` before falling back to compact notation.

Renders a forced-multiline TextInput that grows with its content between minHeight and maxHeight (measured explicit height on iOS/web, native min/max bounds on Android) and scrolls once maxHeight is set.
note: Props are TextInputProps & {minHeight, maxHeight}, so placeholder/editable/etc. pass through. The generator manifest names this component C/Primitives/Input for the same file.

desc: Renders an expo-router Link with target="_blank" that, on non-web platforms, prevents default and opens the href in the in-app browser instead.
note: The design gallery is its ONLY importer — every other `ExternalLink` occurrence in src/ is the lucide-react-native icon of the same name, not this component.

desc: Renders a single text node with a recipient's display name, preferring a saved contact name, then the resolved live identity, then storedName, then the shortened address.

Renders a recipient's trust signal (green BadgeCheck for a starred saved contact, accent UserRound otherwise) beside the resolved name, as a pill (compact), a large name row or bare name (prominent / nameOnly), or an inline line with the identity source on the right; renders nothing when no name resolves.

Renders a small trailing identity glyph for an address: green BadgeCheck (saved contact), the Vela logo (passkey/Vela user), a blue Globe (name-service name), or HelpCircle paired with FileText/Wallet for an unknown contract/EOA.

Renders an amber AlertTriangle banner naming the chains whose RPC failed (one name, or a count when several) with one tappable ChainLogo + "Fix" chip per chain; returns null when no chainId maps to a known network.
note: Same file also exports RpcFixForm and RpcFixModal (mapped in the manifest as C/Sheets/RpcFixForm).

desc: Renders an uppercase, letter-spaced, muted (fg.subtle) heading text used to group de-boxed content sections.

Renders the full-screen bank-style send receipt: a submitted/confirmed/failed status stamp (self-converging by polling userOpHash), the amount or a per-line batch breakdown, from/to identity rows, network, time, tx hash and share / save-to-contacts actions.
Renders an icon plus localized label tinted per status: Clock/warning for pending, CheckCircle2/success for confirmed, XCircle/error for failed.

Renders a spring-pressed pill button — filled ink (primary), filled accent (accent), or transparent with a 1.5px strong border (secondary) — dimmed while disabled and showing an ActivityIndicator in place of the title while loading.
note: The prop type declares only primary | secondary | accent; the manifest's fourth "destructive" variant is a caller-supplied style override (error.base background), not a code variant.

desc: Renders a rounded bg.raised container with a 1px hairline border and small shadow, swapping to a transparent border and medium shadow when `elevated`.

Renders one activity-feed entry: a direction-arrow avatar with a small chain badge, then title + amount, counterparty subtitle + fiat, and an optional time line, with a press spring, a once-only staggered entrance and a brief glow when isNew.

Renders the send-confirm asset cluster: a single chip (TokenLogo + "SYMBOL · network") for one asset, or a collapsed count/total chip that expands into a per-token list for several; returns null with no rows.
Renders a label ↔ value row, optionally monospaced, with a copy affordance that toggles Copy ↔ Check or an open-in-explorer affordance, where `custom` replaces the value cell entirely.
note: Same file also exports the shared Divider (manifest: C/Rows/Divider).

desc: Renders one open (de-boxed) row per fee asset — token logo, this transaction's cost in that coin, and the held balance — marking the selected row with an accent check, showing coins that cannot cover the fee as unselectable, and while `busy` spinning the tapped row while the rest dim and block taps.

Renders the estimated-fee row ("Est. Fee ~x SYM ≈ $y" plus a refresh affordance) that expands into a FeeTokenSelector of native + whitelisted stables, re-estimating the real tx or batch when the fee asset changes.

Renders the split-send (one token → many people) editor: one uniform row per recipient (avatar, auto-growing address field, amount field, remove control hidden at a single row), add-recipient and import affordances, and a total with an over-balance state computed in base units.

Renders one token list row — chain-badged TokenLogo, symbol plus chain label and an optional tap-to-copy contract address, balance (replaced by fixed-size dots when masked) and fiat value — with a leading checkbox whenever `selected` is defined and a press spring.

Renders the pick-a-token list: search field, category chips (all / stable / gas / other), a NetworkFilterButton, an optional count + USD total row, the TokenRow list and an add-token affordance; with `multiSelect` the rows gain checkboxes plus a select-all control and a sticky confirm bar.

Renders the create/edit contact-group view: a back header with a delete action when `editing`, a group-name input, a searchable saved-contacts list whose rows check-toggle membership, and a save button.

Renders the collapsed "技术细节" expert drawer as one grey card: every involved address tagged wallet vs contract with copy/explorer actions, the decoded function signature, the simulated net balance changes, and the raw calldata.

Renders the ERC-20/NFT approval surface: a colored intent eyebrow, a plain-language SummaryLine, the EditableApproveCard spending-cap control, a resulting-total row for increaseAllowance once the on-chain allowance resolves, and risk WarningBanners.

Renders a transaction-simulation summary from one AssetSimResult: a loud "expected to fail" card, the wallet's net asset changes (received green, sent in ink, unverified tokens shown with direction but no amount), or a quiet success reassurance that collapses to a check when every change is corroborated by the hero flows.

Renders an EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls batch as a per-leg breakdown, each leg showing its decoded intent or an EditableApproveCard when it grants an allowance, plus a WarningBanner while any leg still grants broad/unbounded access.

Renders an undecoded eth_sendTransaction: intent eyebrow, a native-value TokenCard hero with its fiat magnitude when the tx carries value, the counterparty ContractBar, the calldata size, and a WarningBanner that reads as a calm "contract interaction" note when simConfident.

Renders an undecoded EIP-712 payload as a field list (primaryType row plus one row per top-level struct key with long hex mid-truncated), the domain's verifying contract as a ContractBar, and a caution WarningBanner.

Renders the descriptor-decoded signing surface: intent eyebrow, then a swap layout (pay TokenCard → FlowArrow → receive TokenCard), a single send hero, or a pure-inflow hero, each with a plain-language SummaryLine, recipient/spender ContractBars, remaining fields as GenericFieldRows and risk WarningBanners.

Renders the counterparty row: identicon + wallet chip for identity 'auto' resolved as an EOA, a neutral glyph + contract chip for 'contract', or no identity chip for 'asset' — with the resolved name, a verified marker, a first-time-address note (worded for inflow) and a single quiet line in compact mode.
Renders the "who's asking" header of a signing sheet: the dApp's own favicon (or a letter monogram when the image fails), its name and domain, and the target chain's ChainLogo plus name.

Renders the spending-cap editor for an approval — requested / balance / custom / revoke modes with a locale-formatted amount input and fiat line, or a grant-vs-revoke choice for a boolean setApprovalForAll — with no unlimited preset.
note: The exported wrapper dispatches to file-private BooleanGrantCard / AmountCard.

desc: Renders the eth_sign blind-hash surface: a red intent eyebrow, a ShieldAlert danger card with the explanation and the opaque hash, and a danger-severity WarningBanner.
Renders a small circled ArrowDown connector between two signing amount cards, tinted danger red when `danger`.
note: AMBIGUOUS NAME: a second, unrelated FlowArrow exists at src/components/send/FlowArrow.tsx (the Send-confirm hairline shaft + MoveDown connector, used by ConfirmStep and TransactionReceipt). The generator manifest maps that one as C/Rows/FlowArrowSend, so C/Signing/FlowArrow is the signing/TokenCard.tsx export.

desc: Renders one decoded label/value row from a ClearSignField, tinting the value red when field.warning and prefixing an amber "Expired" tag when field.expired.
Renders the signing action word either as a large headline (variant 'hero') or as a small uppercase kicker (variant 'eyebrow'), tinted with `color` only when colorEyebrow.

Renders a personal_sign request: the Unicode-decoded message (flagged when the hex is non-printable), and for a SIWE payload the parsed statement plus a domain-binding check against requestOrigin with the matching WarningBanner.

Renders an off-chain permit (Permit2 / ERC-2612 / DAI) verbatim: intent eyebrow colored for unbounded or revoke, a SummaryLine, a token card with the permitted amount tinted error.soft plus an AlertTriangle when unbounded, and a caution WarningBanner when the deadline has passed — no cap editor.
Renders the "signing account" row at the bottom of a signing sheet — label, ContactAvatar, account name and a chevron that toggles a selectable full-address line; returns null without accountName.
Renders the one-sentence plain-language summary under a signing hero, warmed for tone 'caution'/'danger', with each `emphasize` substring re-rendered in semibold; returns null without text.

Renders a signing amount card from a ClearSignField — token logo, signed amount and fiat sub-line — on an open row for variant send/receive and on a tinted card for caution/danger, or logo-less and left-aligned as the hero amount (with the label kept only when heroLabel).
Renders an AlertTriangle plus message banner, filled and tinted per severity ('caution' amber, 'danger' red).
